info.title: OSRMRoute API
info.description: OSRMRoute — a Maps, Routing & Location API platform with 24 services (routing, geocoding, matrix, isochrones, timezone, elevation, geofencing, geometry and more). Authenticate with your API key as the `key` query parameter or an `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header.

get.description: The Routing API calculates routes on the road network between two or more points and returns geometry, distance, estimated duration and optional instructions. Driving coverage is global; walking and cycling use regional graphs. Response time depends on region, graph cache and request complexity. Test representative journeys for your application.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: Transport mode profile. Supported values: driving (car), cycling (bike), walking (pedestrian).

parameters.name: coordinates
parameters.description: Coordinates of the points. Format: lon,lat;lon,lat;lon,lat... (at least 2 points).

parameters.name: overview
parameters.description: Detail level of the returned route geometry: simplified, full (full geometry), false (no geometry).

parameters.name: geometries
parameters.description: Geometry format: geojson (GeoJSON object), polyline (encoded string).

parameters.name: steps
parameters.description: Whether step-by-step instructions are returned for each turn.

post.description: The Route Optimization API turns a fleet's toughest planning problems into efficient delivery plans. Give it a set of vehicles and stops and it solves the Vehicle Routing Problem (VRP) — assigning stops to vehicles and ordering them to minimise total drive time and cost. It handles capacity, time windows and multiple depots, so dispatchers stop planning routes by hand and couriers drive fewer kilometres.

get.description:
The Geocoding API converts free-text addresses into precise coordinates (forward) and coordinates back into readable addresses (reverse). Forward search runs on a self-hosted Photon engine for fast, typo-tolerant, multilingual autocomplete that covers streets, addresses and points of interest; reverse runs on Nominatim for accurate structured results. Relevance controls — location bias, bounding box, category and strict country and city filters — let you tune results for any use case.

Without country, search is global. country=AZ restricts results to Azerbaijan; country=AZ&city=Bakı restricts them to Baku in Azerbaijan. No match returns HTTP 200 with an empty list, without expanding to another area. A city without a country or an invalid country code returns HTTP 400 InvalidGeocodeFilter. lat/lon only affect proximity ranking and cannot override these filters. Records without confirmed city metadata are excluded from city-filtered results.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: The address to search (e.g. "Nizami Street, Baku").

parameters.name: reverse
parameters.description: Must be true to perform reverse geocoding (searching from coordinate to address).

parameters.name: point
parameters.description: Coordinate (lat,lng) to reverse geocode into an address. Required when reverse=true.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of results to return (1–20, default 5).

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Preferred language for result names (e.g. en, az, ru). Defaults to en.

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude to bias results toward (nearby matches rank first). Pair with lon.

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude to bias results toward. Pair with lat.

parameters.name: bbox
parameters.description: Restrict results to a bounding box: minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat.

parameters.name: osm_tag
parameters.description: Filter by OSM tag, e.g. place (settlements) or amenity:cafe. Prefix with ! to exclude.

parameters.name: country
parameters.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example AZ. Returns results only within that country.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: Strict city filter, for example Baku. Requires exactly one country code.

parameters.name: elastic
parameters.description: Elastic (fuzzy, high-recall) search — default true. Tolerates typos, missing diacritics (ə↔e), reordered words, generic words (metro, rayonu) and house numbers. Set false for strict exact matching.

200.description: Matching results within all supplied filters. No match returns an empty list; scope is never expanded.

get.description: The Places API discovers businesses and points of interest around any location — cafes, shops, hotels, ATMs, pharmacies and more. Provide a centre point, a radius and an optional category filter, and it returns nearby POIs sorted by distance, each with its name, type, address and exact coordinates. It runs on fresh OpenStreetMap data, so results stay current as the map evolves.

parameters.description: Search radius in kilometers (0.05–20, default 1).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: OSM tag filter, e.g. amenity:cafe, shop, tourism:hotel. Prefix with ! to exclude. Empty = all POIs.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max results to return (1–50, default 10).

parameters.name: lang
parameters.description: Preferred language for names (e.g. en, az, ru).

Use it for site selection, delivery-zone planning, catchment analysis and 'what's within 15 minutes' features.

get.description: The Map Matching API snaps noisy GPS traces to the real road network. Raw tracking coordinates drift off the road; feed the sequence to this endpoint and it returns a clean, road-aligned path with the roads actually travelled. get.description:
The Directions API returns turn-by-turn navigation between two or more waypoints. Each step comes with human-readable text, distance, duration, maneuver type and the exact location — ready to render in a navigation UI. It supports driving, cycling and walking, plus alternative routes in one call.

The Alternative Routes API computes up to three genuinely different routes between your points in a single request. Ideal for giving drivers a choice, avoiding a blocked road, or comparing a fast vs. shorter path — each option includes full geometry, distance and duration.

get.description:
The Autocomplete API returns fast, typo-tolerant place suggestions as the user types. Each suggestion includes a ready-to-display label, its category and coordinates, so you can power a search box in a few lines. Bias results toward the user with lat/lon, restrict them with a bounding box, or filter by place type.

Without country, search is global. country=AZ restricts results to Azerbaijan; country=AZ&city=Bakı restricts them to Baku in Azerbaijan. No match returns HTTP 200 with an empty list, without expanding to another area. A city without a country or an invalid country code returns HTTP 400 InvalidGeocodeFilter. lat/lon only affect proximity ranking and cannot override these filters. Records without confirmed city metadata are excluded from city-filtered results.
